titulo: Axalta Coating Systems, Feb 2024: about $8.66M of 2023 net sales per job cut announced in 2024. Now the math.
caption:
Axalta Coating Systems, Feb 2024: about $8.66M of 2023 net sales per job cut announced in 2024. Now the math.

Axalta's release for full-year 2023 said the company achieved record sales; an 8-K filed on February 27, 2024 (event date February 26) reported a reduction in workforce of approximately 600 employees.

From the archive: Feb 2024. Not today's news.

The math: $5,200,000,000 (net sales, full year 2023 (the year Axalta called a record for sales)) ÷ approximately 600 jobs = about $8,666,666 of 2023 net sales, the year Axalta called a record for sales, for every job cut announced in February 2024. We round down.
Axalta called 2023 a record for sales. We count sales, not net profit. The 8-K was filed Feb 27, 2024; its event date is Feb 26. The 8-K says approximately 600 employees globally. Net sales are $5.2 billion as Axalta rounds them, so the result says about.

(Our take.) Record, they said. Here is the per-job column.

Sources
F1: Axalta Form 8-K, Exhibit 99.1: Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2023 Results, filed Feb 8, 2024 · https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1616862/000161686224000009/a1220238-kyearxendxex99.htm
F2: Axalta Form 8-K, Item 2.05 (2024 Transformation Initiative), filed Feb 27, 2024 · https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1616862/000161686224000018/axta-20240226.htm

The quotes on screen are copied from the filings. Original music. No narration.
